opts.2: Reduce the size of the crab
opts.3: Add obstacles like rocks that the crab must jump over

assigns.desc: In this activity, students will make a fun game using Scratch Jr. In the game, a crab needs to jump over a flying plastic bag to safely reach the water. Students will design a beach background, draw the plastic bag, and make it move. They will also program the crab to jump and move forward. Students will add a scoring system, and create screens for winning and losing. Through this project, students will learn how pollution affects sea animals and how to make an interactive game using coding blocks.

units.desc: Trigger Blocks: Start on Green Flag, Start on Tap Motion Blocks: Move Right, Move Left, Repeat Forever Look Blocks: Grow/Shrink, Change Colors Sound Blocks: Pop sound Paint Editor: Create and modify sprites and backgrounds Game Design: How to set up a playable game with obstacles and interactions
units.rwc: Notebook, Pencil, Eraser, Smartphone, Scratch Jr App

vids.desc: In this activity, students will be walked through the steps to create a desert game in Scratch Jr. They will learn how to modify the desert background, create and resize sprites like the cactus and lizard, change sprite colors and then code them using motion, trigger, and sound blocks. By the end, they will have a fully functional game where to avoid the cactus and they must tap the lizard to make it hop forward without touching the cactus.

opts.1: To help her hop forward without hitting the cactus

qs.q: If Lizzy hops low and hits the cactus, what should we change in the game?

qs.q: Priya wants to make her lizard hop over a moving cactus in her desert game. What is the best way for her to create this fun challenge?

opts.1: Use two scripts on the lizard, one to hop up and one to move forward, and run them together using the same start block.
opts.2: Use the "shrink" block to make the cactus disappear
opts.3: Use the "sound" block to add music

qs.q: Arjun wants his game to look like daytime. Which is the best decision for him to make his desert game bright and sunny?

opts.2: Change the sky color to blue and the sand color to yellow
